closed.title: Cline Test READY mutates live provider authority
closed.detail: The active rebuild-settings.js Test READY path calls providerConfigure without discoverOnly. AgentRuntimeAdapter therefore executes _installProvider(), changing service.provider, service.agent.provider and providerSelection while persist:false leaves durable preferences unchanged. This behavior existed in the first canonical Access commit and is an inherited design defect, not a recent regression.

next_acceptance.question: What is the smallest existing-provider-layer primitive that can test a candidate provider/model for agent readiness without installing it as the active runtime provider?
next_acceptance.observable: Source mapping must identify the active provider object, readiness registry/cache key, provider creation path and capability probe entry point, and show a regression contract where testing candidate B leaves active provider A unchanged before, during and after both pass and fail outcomes.
next_acceptance.falsifier: If the existing readiness implementation intrinsically depends on service.provider and cannot be safely parameterized without duplicating provider/session authority, do not patch the UI alone; redesign the readiness boundary at the proven provider owner first.
